PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: FOV-based ADS sensitivity, per-weapon zoom and smooth zoom
PluginData.Description:
Aim-down-sights tuning for hand weapons.
FOV-based sensitivity: replaces vanilla's flat 0.6x ironsight sensitivity with monitor distance scaling (coefficient 1.33 by default, the CoD / Battlefield default).
Per-weapon zoom: set the magnification of every hand weapon, modded guns included.
Smooth zoom: eased zoom in and out with adjustable time.
Client-side only. Works on any server.
